communication_goal: 把模糊审美反馈变成可检查的界面要求。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The stick-figure programmer stands at left and uses an open-hand gesture toward a large upright desktop monitor at center. The monitor screen is fully visible and displays a simple unlabelled wireframe with three horizontal outlined rectangles and two small blank rounded rectangular button shapes; no words, letters, numbers or code. The white OpenAI knot floats to the right as the conversation partner. Keep the whole screen unobstructed, clearly separate from the pointing hand, and make its visible inner display area large for a learning crop. Only the monitor and its simple support stand.

coverage_review.scope: V007 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V007.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：黑底白线单幅插画，一个成年火柴人和一个可辨认的白色 OpenAI 六环结标识，底图无对白文字。框选显示器实际内屏，避开支架和外壳；无文字线框，不把间距或一致性要求当作已达标事实。
